data.body: MEASUREMENTS THAT BEAR ON THE REPORT. (1) Replicability cannot be measured by text matching. Across 8 merged per-plan ballots, 1340 items appear in one draw, 13 in two, 2 in three; all 15 multi-draw items are rebar and all 15 are one of two deterministic banner rows. No arm reproduced a substantive finding's text across runs. Prior work in the study agrees from the other direction: of 618 judge-confirmed same-defect pairs, zero reach jaccard 0.5 and a five-field matcher recovers 44%. Replicability must therefore come from judges linking same-issue rows; merge_ballot records draw_multiplicity_is_a_lower_bound in every artifact so the distribution cannot be quoted as the answer. (2) rebar reads draw 1 from rebar_findings.json (surfaced + overflow + indeterminate) and draws 2-3 from verdict documents (blocking + advisory, i.e. surfaced only). Only rebar uses two readers. Magnitude on complete plans: 2948-48e5-PASS draw 1 holds 27 rows of which 2 were surfaced; 5200-e04e-PASS holds 32 of which 19 were surfaced; on 86ac-086a-PASS and 2127-348c-PASS the populations nearly agree. No row carries a surfaced/suppressed marker. Operator direction is to keep the canonical and carry this as a reporting caveat. (3) Independence: 40 cells report PARTIAL on 'three distinct cost records' across ce, rebar, sp and sp5 -- draw 1 is a frozen earlier-wave canonical with no cost record at the probed path. Only gstack reaches three. mini's 10 step-limit FAILs come from globbing every on-disk artifact including A5-excluded ones; among campaign-tagged mini draws every step limit is 260.
